decisions.reason: As a recently launched but only lightly promoted niche agricultural crate, it carries some risk, yet a large German plastics producer would usually give such a reusable product more time in the market.
A foldable large container with its own product page fits industrial logistics well and is likely viewed as a strategic offering worth retaining.
A stackable plastic crate is a standard adjacent product for this industry, so despite modest website emphasis it is likely to remain in the range.
A medium-duty rackable pallet fits the firm's core transport-packaging portfolio and would normally be kept beyond its first year unless results were clearly poor.
A spill-retention pallet addresses a clear compliance and safety need, and its dedicated page suggests strong commitment by the firm.
A plastic pallet with load retainers is closely aligned with the company's established pallet business and dedicated marketing support points to continued commercialization.
